title: Henki's Vanilla+++
description: A simple modpack to make MInecraft vanilla a little nicer.
body:
Feel the fresh breeze on your skin, smell the gras of the vallay, listen to the sounds of a village or dive into deep waters.

If you are looking for a nice looking, vanilla experience orientated modpack, you will maybe enjoy this pack. Slightly handpicked changes in sound and optic. Huge performance boost for medium PC's while running nice shaderpacks and alot of tiny highlights. Here you can find a small selection of mods included. All mods working clientside, no need to install on your server!

### optical changes
- Complementary Shaders - Reimagined (best shader i my mind);
- 3D crops Revamped (just looks nice);
- 3D crops Revamped (just looks nice);
- 3D rails/ladders (also looks nice (= );
- Bare Bone (Texturepack from the minecraft trailers)
- ...
### performance
- Fabric API
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- Sodium
- Iris Shaders (optifine like performance changes)
- ...
### quality of life
- AppleSkin (better control of hunger and food)
- Durability Notifier (alarmtone when tools are unter set durability)
- Effect Timer Plus (see how long your buffs last)
- Clean F3 (for better overvier in your F3 console)
- ...
### ambience
- AmbientSounds (sounds like the "real" nature)
- Fresh Animations (better movement for all mobs)
- Cubic Sun & Moon (does what it says)
- ... and many many more. 

I'm engaged to update and optimise this pack asap.
So, if you just want a new start with the good old vanilla minecraft, download now :)
